drive_id: # Google Drive files (flyer images and PDFs) that the website must NOT show, because they print a member's personal e-mail, or (in a document) a personal phone number (Tradition Eleven). Flyers (pictures and calendar PDF flyers) are not held for phone numbers (owner's rule, 2026-10-22). Any IMG: or Link: line in Google Calendar that points to one of these ids is left out of every page, events.json and the .ics files.

# To release a file: in Google Drive open it, choose Manage versions > Upload new version with the personal details removed (the id stays the same), then delete its row here. node scripts/check-calendar.mjs lists the held files that the calendar still uses.
# Columns: drive_id = the long id in the Drive link; reason = what the file shows (never write the details themselves); held_on = date the hold started (YYYY-MM-DD); notes = where the file is used.
